meta.interpro: Domains: InterPro entries of type domain or repeat (homologous superfamilies for a protein with neither). Families: entries of type family and the other homologous superfamilies. Each entry's member-database hits merged where they overlap; an entry covering the same stretch as a more widely used one of its kind (80% reciprocal overlap) is a note on it
meta.rule: Reviewed human proteins of UniProt 2026_03 with no methylarginine site in the default view; lower-confidence sites counted from docs/data/methylarg_sites_all.json
meta.shard_rule: h = 0; for each character c: h = (h * 31 + code(c)) mod 1000003; shard = h mod shards
